news.title: SER Industries Limited to Report Q3, 2026 Results on Feb 14, 2026
news.body: SER Industries Limited announced that they will report Q3, 2026 results at 12:15 PM, Indian Standard Time on Feb 14, 2026

news.title: High number of new and inexperienced directors
news.body: There are 5 new directors who have joined the board in the last 3 years. The company's board is composed of: 5 new directors. No experienced directors. No highly experienced directors. Independent Director Om Singh is the most experienced director on the board, commencing their role in 2025. The following issues are considered to be risks according to the Simply Wall St Risk Model: Lack of board continuity. Lack of experienced directors.

news.title: Ser Industries Limited Announces Resignation of Directors, Effective from 5 January 2026
news.body: SER Industries Limited announced the following changes in the composition of the Board of Directors of the Company: Mr. Narendra Goel (DIN: 00327187) has tendered his resignation from the position of Whole-time director of the Company, with effect from the close of business hours on 5th January 2026, due to personal preoccupations, he is unable to continue serving on the Board. Mr. Arvind Khot (DIN: 06732061) has tendered his resignation from the position of Director of the Company, with effect from the close of business hours on 5th January 2026, due to personal preoccupations, he is unable to continue serving on the Board.

news.title: Ser Industries Limited Announces Resignation of Chief Financial Officer Sanjay Bihari Pal, Effective January 5, 2026
news.body: SER Industries Limited announced the resignation of Mr. Sanjay Bihari Pal from the position of Chief Financial Officer of the company, with effect from the close of business hours on January 5, 2026. Mr. Sanjay Bihari Pal submitted a formal resignation letter to the Board of Directors, stating his resignation from the position of Chief Financial Officer (“CFO”) of SER Industries Limited, effective January 5, 2026. Mr. Sanjay Bihari Pal committed to ensuring a smooth transition of responsibilities and completing outstanding tasks before his departure.

news.title: Less than half of directors are independent
news.body: Following the recent departure of a director, there are only 2 independent directors on the board. The company's board is composed of: 2 independent directors. 4 non-independent directors. Independent Director Aarti Juneja was the last independent director to join the board, commencing their role in 2025. The company's minority of independent directors is a risk according to the Simply Wall St Risk Model.
